metrics.ownAPlusOnePerOwnAAttempt: own active A rounds ending with own +1 / all own active A rounds
metrics.opponentAWinPerOpponentAAttempt: opponent active A rounds ending with opponent +2/+3 / all opponent active A rounds

metrics.deltaTable: exact next-state level deltas and termination; not inferred match value
